Fresh Reply and Reply All put the original and available earlier conversation text inside Message, where you can edit or remove it. Quoted HTML uses the original preview’s layout defaults for tables, images and spacing, without changing how the rest of your draft is displayed. Save draft, Preview Send, Send and Schedule use only the edited Message; no hidden original is appended. The separate original preview is reference only and can differ from your edited quote. Only the captured mailbox/thread up to the selected message is used; later messages, other accounts and unsent drafts are excluded. Cached reads do not download bodies, mark messages read or send history to AI. Gmail label copies use existing conversation deduplication; exact attributed quotes already present in newer included text are not appended again, while identical unquoted deliveries remain distinct. Missing bodies are labelled and their snippets are not sent as full messages. Incomplete/uncertain text and omitted history are disclosed. Additional history is limited to 100 earlier messages and a 2-million-character content budget, counting cached HTML, plain text and outgoing quotes; the original is not truncated. Editable quotes preserve safe HTML formatting from the original, including supported headings, emphasis, lists, tables, links, colors and embedded raster images. Missing or unsupported HTML uses a plain-text fallback from the available body, never a snippet. Remote images and CSS resources stay blocked in Message even if allowed in the reference preview; scripts, active content and unresolved CID images are removed. Each message is sanitized separately so its styles cannot affect another quote or your reply. Excessive quoted CSS expansion falls back to text with a notice; additional history also counts sanitized output toward its existing budget. Forward keeps its existing quote behavior. The reference preview uses the received-mail sanitizer and remote-image policy. Hide/Show and Collapse change only that preview. Earlier text is added after loading only while the editable quote is untouched; editing or deleting it preserves your changes and shows a notice instead of restoring history. AI writing, suggested replies and signatures preserve the edited quote without adding cached earlier history to AI input. Save, Send and Schedule wait for context/identity checks; typing and Close remain available. Resumed drafts and recovered scheduled messages retain their saved content. No new provider permission or bot/CLI command is added.
